question: The pulmonary surfactant:

options.opa: Increase the work done to inflate the lung.
options.opb: It is a mixture of monosaccharides and polysaccharides.
options.opc: Decreases the surface tension of the alveoli.
options.opd: It is produced by the endothelial cells of the alveolar capillaries.

analysis: Pulmonary surfactant is a substance produced by type II alveolar cells in the lungs. Its main function is to decrease the surface tension of the alveoli, preventing their collapse at the end of expiration and reducing the work required to inflate the lungs.
